name: Cannonbolt
abilities: High-speed rolling, ricocheting and slamming attacks
Energy/laser deflection and electricity conduction via shell
Acid, lava, cold and reentry-heat resistance
Sightless sensing via fur when rolled
Can carry passengers inside his shell
weaknesses: Top-heavy and clumsy on two legs
Cannot roll on slippery surfaces (Gourmand slime) or through strong adhesives
Vulnerable to electricity and extreme heat when uncurled
summary: The yellow-plated pillbug that saved the world from the Great One: rolls into a near-indestructible cannonball and bowls through anything.
traits: First alien Ben unlocked after the original ten
Species used the ball form only for defence until Ben weaponised it
Home planet Arburia was destroyed by the Great One
notableFeats: Destroyed the Great One when every other alien failed (The Big Tick)
Defeated Kevin 11 on the Megacruiser (Grudge Match)
Survived reentry from space with Max and Gwen inside (Be Afraid of the Dark)
Kicked Vilgax into the Codon Stream (Primus)
Reverted DNAliens to humans by the dozen (War of the Worlds: Part 1)
Defeated General Attea, SixSix, SevenSeven and EightEight (Vilgax Must Croak)

appearances.designNotes: White-and-black body with yellow exo-plates, sharp teeth, yellow eyes, original Omnitrix on the forehead. Ben 10,000's version has black 'pants' colouring, longer grey-lined claws and the Omnitrix on top of the head.
Fuller human-like teeth, no chest stripe, green eyes, Omnitrix on chest (shared AF/UA 'UAF' design).
Same UAF design as Alien Force with the Ultimatrix on his chest; goes Ultimate several times.

OS chest stripe returns and extends to the belly, hexagonal yellow bolts, three back plates, flat palms, eyes no longer touching the shoulders. 16-year-old wears the Omnitrix on his chest; 11-year-old wears a green Omnitrix on his forehead.

scoring.rationale: Rolled up he is nearly invulnerable - survives atmospheric reentry, deflects lasers - and hits like a wrecking ball at speed. Clumsy on his feet, one-note tactically, and slippery or sticky floors stop him cold.

notes: AF: War of the Worlds: Part 1 (wiki S1, Ben 15) then Vengeance of Vilgax: Part 1 and Primus (wiki S2, Ben 16).
UA 'Fame' is a TV-footage cameo; first real UA use is Duped (by 'Sensitive Ben', a personality-split Ben).
Also used by Gwen in Ben's body (A Change of Face), a Plant Clone Ben (The Big Story), No Watch Ben and Gwen 10 (And Then There Was Ben) - not counted.
